SELECT projects.id, projects.name, projects.client_name, projects.location, projects.description, projects.created_at, projects.updated_at 
FROM projects 
WHERE projects.id = $1::UUID

SELECT projectplants.project_id AS projectplants_project_id, projectplants.plant_id AS projectplants_plant_id, projectplants.notes AS projectplants_notes, projectplants.quantity AS projectplants_quantity, projectplants.unit AS projectplants_unit, projectplants.optimum_height_size AS projectplants_optimum_height_size, projectplants.rate AS projectplants_rate, taxons_1.id AS taxons_1_id, taxons_1.name AS taxons_1_name, taxons_1.rank AS taxons_1_rank, taxons_1.parent_id AS taxons_1_parent_id, taxons_1.description AS taxons_1_description, taxons_1.created_at AS taxons_1_created_at, taxons_1.updated_at AS taxons_1_updated_at, plants_1.id AS plants_1_id, plants_1.taxon_id AS plants_1_taxon_id, plants_1.scientific_name AS plants_1_scientific_name, plants_1.common_name AS plants_1_common_name, plants_1.category AS plants_1_category, plants_1.planting_place AS plants_1_planting_place, plants_1.description AS plants_1_description, plants_1.common_diseases AS plants_1_common_diseases, plants_1.care_data AS plants_1_care_data, plants_1.icon_url AS plants_1_icon_url, plants_1.image_url AS plants_1_image_url, plants_1.created_at AS plants_1_created_at 
FROM projectplants LEFT OUTER JOIN plants AS plants_1 ON plants_1.id = projectplants.plant_id LEFT OUTER JOIN taxons AS taxons_1 ON taxons_1.id = plants_1.taxon_id 
WHERE projectplants.project_id IN ($1::UUID)
